verdict.rationale: Granola offers an API and MCP server that let AI agents query notes across the workspace and chat workflows can act on individual meetings (draft emails, sync to CRM), but there's no documented bulk operation—like batch tagging, bulk export beyond CSV, or applying an action across many selected notes simultaneously. missing for 10: documented bulk-edit/bulk-action endpoints, evidence of applying single commands across many items at once, independent confirmation of bulk API usage patterns.
